description_en: Queries the list of notarization and traceability business chains
description_zh: 用于查询存证与溯源业务链列表
kebab_example: aliyun ltl list-proof-chain --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --num 1 --size 2 --name '某业务链' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProofChain

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The page number to display in the returned results. The minimum value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最小取值是1
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display per page in the returned results. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
The name of the business chain to query.

> If this parameter is not specified, all notarization service business chains are queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的业务链名称。

> 不传则查询所有存证服务业务链
parameters.name: name
